ai_title:
Solvia is not just an app,
it's a guide by your side.
ai_desc: With AI-powered document analysis, 24/7 Solvi Bot, and 4-language support, you will never get lost in Italy.
ai_doc_desc: Upload a photo of an official Italian document — the app analyzes it in seconds. It automatically extracts what the document is, why it matters, and what you need to do. All documents from Codice Fiscale to Permesso are supported.
ai_bot_desc: Ask Solvi anything on your mind about Italy. Document guide, housing, legal procedures, city guide — Solvi Bot provides AI-powered, instant, and accurate answers. No need to search forums for hours anymore.
ai_bot_msg1: Which city are you in for Codice Fiscale? Let me find the nearest Agenzia delle Entrate. 📍
house_title:
Finding housing in Italy
is now this easy.
house_desc: View and filter ads from real users, message directly. Or share your own room, rent together.
house_ad_title:
Find the room that suits you,
get in touch instantly
house_ad_bullet1: Filter by city, max rent, furniture status (fully/partially/unfurnished)
house_ad_bullet2: Filter by landlord gender and spoken language
house_ad_bullet3: Real-time updated listings, direct message to the advertiser
house_ad_bullet4: ⚡ Featured ads are highlighted with a red border — seen by more people
house_create_desc: Upload photos, enter rent details and house info, specify location. Your listing is instantly visible to all users. ⚡ Boost your listing to reach more people.
house_rent_desc: Match with people who want to rent the same house together. Create a profile, specify preferences, and find your perfect roommate. Split the cost, share the experience.
house_dorms_desc: Current information, locations, and application processes for student dormitories across Italy are listed in Solvia.
social_title:
Connect in real-time
with people in Italy.
social_desc: With community boards, private messaging, post translation, and instant notifications, you are at the heart of the community in Italy.
social_comm_desc: Share posts, comment, and reply in real-time. Likes and comments are updated instantly. Trending posts are marked with a 🔥 flame icon. Edit or delete your own posts.
social_trans_desc: Every post can be translated to the user's language with a single click. Italian, Turkish, English, Arabic — join the community without language barriers.
social_chat_desc: Real-time messaging between two users. Share ads or profiles, see read receipts. Block users or delete chat history.
step_desc: Easily complete official processes in Italy with step-by-step guides tailored to your city.
step_item1_desc: The fundamental step for all official procedures in Italy. Go to any Agenzia delle Entrate with your passport.
step_item2_desc: Mandatory if you stay in Italy for more than 90 days. Applications are made from post office counters (Sportello Amico).
step_item3_desc: Report your address to the Municipality (Comune). Required to benefit from healthcare services.
step_item4_desc: By registering with the ASL (Azienda Sanitaria Locale), you can benefit from free healthcare services.
step_vis_tip_desc: Obtain the Kit postale from major post offices. Fill in the form completely. Set a reminder to not miss your appointment date.

comm_rem_desc: Never miss important deadlines, appointments, and document renewal dates.
comm_caf_desc: Centro di Assistenza Fiscale — a comprehensive guide for tax declaration and social benefits applications.
other_lang_desc: Full support for Turkish, Italian, and English. Automatic switch based on language preference.

other_terms_desc: Transparent terms of service. Simple language, clear content.
other_cookies_desc: Completely control which cookies you allow.

terms_subtitle: Please read these Terms of Use carefully before using the Solvia mobile application. By downloading the application or using the services, you agree to these terms.
terms_sec1_desc: Solvia is intended solely for use by individuals aged 18 and over. Persons under 18 are prohibited from using the application.
terms_sec2_p1: Verification (KYC) with an official passport or identity card is mandatory to create ads, search for roommates, or send messages.
terms_sec2_p2: The use of fake, invalid, or third-party documents is strictly prohibited. If such attempts are detected, the account will be closed immediately and permanently.
terms_sec3_title: 3. Content Rules and Zero Tolerance Policy
terms_sec3_p1: No illegal, threatening, insulting, discriminatory, obscene, or hate speech content is allowed.
terms_sec3_p2: Listings or messages suspected of violating rules can be reported from within the app and will be reviewed within 24 hours.
terms_sec3_p3: Distracting or harassing users can be blocked. The blocked person will not be able to contact you again.

terms_sec4_p2: Solvia cannot be held responsible for disputes arising from lease agreements, deposits, and payments. Any transaction is at the user's own risk.
terms_sec5_title: 5. Premium Subscription Options (RevenueCat) and Listing Boost Services
terms_sec5_desc: All financial transactions are processed through Apple App Store and Google Play Store via the RevenueCat infrastructure. Premium members receive unlimited listings, access to all bureaucracy guides, ad-free experience, fast KYC verification, and priority support. In addition, all plans include 2 free "Showcase / Boost" credits per month, each valid for 1 day (24 hours). Unused credits do not roll over to the next month.
terms_plan1_desc: Renews automatically every month unless canceled
terms_sec5_note: All subscription plans renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period via the respective store settings (Google Play / App Store).

terms_sec6_desc: Temporary interruptions may occur due to maintenance and development. Solvia reserves the right to modify or terminate features at any time.
terms_sec7_desc: In case of disputes regarding these Terms of Use, the laws of the country where the developer is established shall apply.

priv_subtitle: Solvia is a mobile application and platform developed to simplify life in Italy. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, used, stored, and protected when you use the Solvia app and services. By using our services, you agree to the data practices described in this policy.
priv_sec1_item1_desc: Full name, email, password, and profile picture provided during registration or login.
priv_sec1_item2_desc: Official passport or identity card photos uploaded to prevent fake listings and fraud.
priv_sec1_item3_desc: Cities searched, area preferences, and language selection (Turkish, English, Italian, Arabic).
priv_sec1_item4_desc: Your messages in the in-app chat feature.
priv_sec1_item5_desc: Premium subscriptions are processed via Apple App Store and Google Play. Sensitive information like card numbers is never stored on Solvia servers.
priv_sec2_p1: • Provide core features such as housing listings, room search, and messaging
priv_sec2_p2: • Verify user identity via KYC and increase community safety
priv_sec2_p3: • Provide personalized document guides specific to your city
priv_sec2_p4: • Send reminders for appointments and deadlines
priv_sec2_p5: • Improve service quality and resolve technical issues
priv_sec3_desc: Your personal data and KYC documents are stored on secure servers with industry-standard encryption methods. Identity documents are only reviewed by authorized system administrators for verification. Once verified, documents are moved to encrypted archive servers and never shared with third parties.
priv_sec4_desc: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Data is only shared in the following cases:
priv_sec4_p2: • Cloud server providers — for secure hosting
priv_sec4_p3: • Legal obligations — in line with requests from official authorities
priv_sec5_item1_desc: You can view or update your registered information.
priv_sec5_item2_desc: You can request this via the "Delete My Account" button in the Settings / Profile menu, or by emailing info@solviaai.it.
priv_sec5_item3_desc: Your profile info, listings, message history, and all KYC documents are permanently deleted.
priv_sec6_desc: Solvia is intended only for individuals aged 18 and over. If we realize we have collected data from minors under 18, we delete this data immediately.
priv_sec7_desc: We may update this policy from time to time. In case of significant changes, users will be informed via in-app notifications or email.
priv_sec8_desc:
For questions and requests regarding the Privacy Policy or your personal data:
info@solviaai.it
